c) Now go to Vocabulary Focus 7A p.167

Read and listen to the text. Match pictures 1-6 with phrases in bold a-f. 🔊 Track 07.01

Erik works in the city centre and he a takes the train to work every morning. He b gets on the train at Kings Park Station, near his home. Then he c changes trains at Central Station in the city centre and he d gets off the train at Riverside Station, near his office. He usually gets to Kings Park Station at 8:00, so he can e catch the train at 8:05, but sometimes he's a few minutes late and he f misses the train. Then he has to wait for the next train.
e. Choose the correct verbs.
f. Listen and check your answer. 🔊 Track 07.02

  4. 4. The concert finished at 9:30, so we just / the last tram.
